title: Gixxer 150 (Dark Edition)
description: Representing Suzuki's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the Suzuki Gixxer 150 (Dark Edition) is delivers muscular mid-range acceleration paired with effortless city maneuvering. A 150cc powerplant pumps out 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
